title: Dong Van and Ma Pi Leng
summary: Sleep in Dong Van, walk the old quarter, then give the morning to Ma Pi Leng. The four-day loop is the longer trip. This plan is the stone town and the pass.

days.title: Day 1 — Dong Van
days.body: Breakfast in town is pho, then the road into Dong Van. Walk the old quarter, about 40 houses from 1890, and use the market at night or early morning. Sunday is the market day. Arrive before sunset.

days.title: Day 2 — Ma Pi Leng
days.body: Meo Vac is 24 km from Dong Van and takes most of a morning if you stop. Ride the rim above the Nho Que and stop only where the shoulder allows. Do not ride it after dark.

stops.name: Pho
stops.note: Eat pho in town before the ride toward Dong Van.

stops.name: Dong Van
stops.note: Arrive before sunset, walk the old quarter, and stay the night.

stops.name: Ma Pi Leng Pass
stops.note: Give the next morning to the pass above the Nho Que.

seoTitle: Dong Van and Ma Pi Leng in two days
seoDescription: A two-day Ha Giang plan: the old quarter in Dong Van, then Ma Pi Leng, 24 km and most of a morning on the way to Meo Vac.
